title: Subscriptions, Management Groups, Policy, Locks, Tags and Costs

header.html: Implement and manage Azure Policy; configure resource locks; apply and manage tags; manage resource groups; manage subscriptions; manage costs by using alerts, budgets and Azure Advisor recommendations; configure management groups
the official Microsoft Learn AZ-104 study guide, skills measured as of October 26, 2023

html:
1The organization structure

Level Purpose
Management group Container for subscriptions; apply policy and RBAC once for many subscriptions; nest up to six levels below the root [Verify live]
Subscription Billing and access boundary; also holds quotas
Resource group Logical container for resources with the same lifecycle
Resource The Azure service instance

A resource group has a location only for its metadata; its resources can be in other regions. Deleting a resource group deletes everything in it. Resources can be moved between resource groups and subscriptions (not all types). Subscriptions can be moved between management groups.

Exam tip

. "Apply the same policy to many subscriptions" = a management group.

2Azure Policy

Azure Policy makes sure resources follow your rules (allowed regions, required tags, allowed sizes). It evaluates resources and can block, flag or fix them.

Concept Meaning
Policy definition One rule with a condition and an effect
Initiative A group of definitions managed together
Assignment Applies a definition or initiative to a scope (with optional exclusions)
Effects Deny (block the request), Audit (flag only), Append / Modify (add or change properties such as tags), DeployIfNotExists (deploy a related resource)
Remediation task Fixes existing non-compliant resources (needs a managed identity)
Compliance The dashboard of compliant and non-compliant resources
Exam tip

. Policy checks the resource's properties (what is allowed). RBAC controls the user's permissions (who can act). "Prevent creating VMs outside two regions" = Policy with Deny.

3Resource locks

Lock Effect
Delete (CanNotDelete) Users can read and modify, but cannot delete
Read-only Users can only read; no changes or deletes

Locks apply to a subscription, resource group or resource, are inherited by child resources, and override RBAC permissions, even for Owners. To change a locked resource you must remove the lock first.

4Tags

Tags are name-value pairs on resources, resource groups and subscriptions (for example Environment: Production, CostCenter: 1234). Use them to organize, report on cost and automate.

Fact Detail
Inheritance Tags are not inherited from resource groups by default; use Azure Policy (Modify / Append) to apply or inherit them
Cost Cost analysis can group by tag
Limit Up to 50 tag pairs per resource [Verify live]

5Costs

Tool What it does
Cost analysis See and break down spending (by resource group, tag, service)
Budgets Set a spending threshold and alerts; a budget does not stop spending
Cost alerts Notify at budget percentages or on anomalies
Azure Advisor Recommendations for cost, reliability, security, operational excellence and performance (for example, resize or shut down underused VMs)
Exam tip

. A budget alerts you; it does not shut resources down. To stop spending automatically you must act on the alert (for example an action group that runs automation).

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1An organization wants to prevent resources from being created outside two approved regions in all subscriptions. What should be used?

  • AA Delete lock on every subscription so that other regions cannot be used
  • BA budget with an alert at 100 percent of the planned monthly spending
  • CAn Azure Policy assignment with a Deny effect at a management group
  • DA tag named Region on every resource group in each subscription
Show the answer

Answer: C. Policy with Deny at a management group enforces the region rule across subscriptions.

S2An administrator wants users to modify a production storage account but never delete it. What should be applied?

  • AA Read-only lock
  • BA Reader role
  • CA tag
  • DA Delete (CanNotDelete) lock
Show the answer

Answer: D. A CanNotDelete lock allows changes but blocks deletion.

S3An Owner cannot delete a resource. What is the likely cause?

  • AA missing tag
  • BA budget alert
  • CA management group
  • DA resource lock
Show the answer

Answer: D. Locks override even Owner permissions.

S4Resources should inherit the CostCenter tag from their resource group. What should the administrator use?

  • AAn Azure Policy with the Modify effect
  • BA resource lock that copies the tag from the resource group
  • CA budget that is scoped to the resource group with the tag
  • DA Reader role on the resource group so that tags are visible
Show the answer

Answer: A. Tags are not inherited by default; a Modify policy can apply them.

S5A team wants an email when spending reaches 80 percent of the monthly plan. What should be created?

  • AA policy initiative
  • BA budget with an alert
  • CA Delete lock
  • DA dynamic group
Show the answer

Answer: B. Budgets send alerts at configured thresholds.

S6Which tool recommends resizing underused virtual machines to save money?

  • AAzure Policy
  • BResource locks
  • CManagement groups
  • DAzure Advisor
Show the answer

Answer: D. Advisor gives cost and other recommendations.

6.2 Recall questions

R1What is the purpose of a management group?

Show the answer

To organize subscriptions and apply policy and RBAC across them.

R2Name two Azure Policy effects.

Show the answer

For example Deny and Audit (also Modify, Append, DeployIfNotExists).

R3What does a Read-only lock allow?

Show the answer

Only reading; no changes or deletions.

R4Are tags inherited by default?

Show the answer

No.

R5Does a budget stop spending?

Show the answer

No, it only alerts.

R6What happens when a resource group is deleted?

Show the answer

All its resources are deleted.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Hierarchy management group > subscription > resource group > resource
Policy definition, initiative, assignment; Deny, Audit, Modify, DeployIfNotExists; remediation
Locks CanNotDelete, Read-only; inherited; override RBAC
Tags name-value pairs; not inherited; group costs by tag
Costs budgets and alerts (no auto-stop), cost analysis, Advisor
